issues: expo-app/package.json is not valid JSON – the file contains escaped newline characters (e.g., "{\\n  \"name\" ...}") instead of proper JSON with real line breaks. This causes the JSON syntax check to fail. Rewrite the file as a normal JSON document without the backslashes so it can be parsed correctly.

TypeScript compilation fails because JSX is not enabled for the project root. The static validator runs `tsc` from the repo root, but there is no tsconfig.json there, so the default compiler settings lack the `jsx` option. Add a tsconfig.json at the repository root (or move/extend the existing expo-app/tsconfig.json) that sets `"jsx": "react-jsx"` (and appropriate `include` paths such as "expo-app/**/*.tsx") so that .tsx files compile without the "Cannot use JSX unless the '--jsx' flag is provided" errors.
feedback: The backend passes all acceptance tests, but the frontend source does not compile. Fix the malformed package.json and provide a proper TypeScript configuration at the repo root (or adjust the existing one) to enable JSX compilation. After these changes the static validation should succeed.
